**Allowed origins:** `http://localhost:4200` (exact), plus any subdomain of `*.pages.dev` and `*.workers.dev` (via `.endsWith()` checks).

**Where it's defined:** `worker/src/index.ts`, in the `cors({ origin: (origin) => {...} })` callback passed to `app.use('*', cors({...}))` (around line 20).

**To add a new custom domain:** add a condition inside that same `origin` function, e.g.:
```ts
origin === 'https://your-custom-domain.com' ||
```
It must be a function (not an array) since Hono only matches array entries as exact strings — no wildcard support there. See `docs/DEPLOYMENT_NOTES.md#4-cors` for more detail.
